integrity: Primary source arXiv:2308.15603 was first posted 2023-08-29, confirmed from the original arXiv listing. Supporting paper arXiv:0905.3281 predates it and establishes the Petersen special case. All computations were run from the included standalone script and report their explicit finite coverage.
scientific_limitations: The formula applies to ordinary domination in K(n,2), n>=4, and not to general K(n,r). The Petersen case and minimum domination number were previously known; only the all-order distribution for n>=6 with its explicit overlap enumeration is advanced. Finite graph checks do not replace the infinite proof. Unindexed equivalent publications remain possible; independent mathematical audit has not occurred.
title: Complete domination polynomials of two-subset Kneser graphs
